study.question: With native click gradients fixed, does the effect of the unsuccessful norm-restored auxiliary summary-direction intervention differ between cart/favorite and buy, and can a selective implementation exceed the native compressed/task-conditioned incumbent at equal learned capacity and measured cost?
study.hypothesis: Observed r0068 A00(native all)=0.6685268680116033 click AUC, primary-only intervention=0.6684334100415259, auxiliary-only=0.6681700018870619, both=0.6679993260149861. Auxiliary-only changes cart AUC 0.8049769604->0.8062381025 and fav 0.8150707714->0.8231454203 but buy 0.8304986712->0.8269567256. This opposing task pattern motivates, but does not establish, task heterogeneity. A provisional mechanism is that the native buy summary-update direction is useful for downstream shared-context learning whereas cart/fav tolerate or benefit from the transformed direction. A cart/fav-only intervention with native buy may recover click quality relative to all-aux intervention. Because auxiliary summary inputs are detached, this cannot be a direct auxiliary-summary gradient into shared history embeddings: influence can arise through updated task-specific history projections, later query/context learning and host global dense clipping. The grouping and hypothesis are exploratory selections from existing validation feedback.

nearest_work.difference: Pinned native r0068 standalone source read and retained verbatim except the new per-label selection and constructor/config. The inherited _SummaryProductVJP is unchanged. Click is frozen native while cart/fav and buy modes vary independently. No new forward architecture or verified novelty is claimed.

Its source and full receipt were inspected. It transforms all auxiliary summary VJPs together. This study splits cart/fav from buy to identify heterogeneity and interaction, including a replay of the unsuccessful aggregate cell.

Archived exact-version primary text lines250-283 explains target-conditioned local activation and unnormalized weights; adapted baseline source inspected. We retain that inherited scoring idea in compressed blocks but this intervention concerns task-specific summary learning, not a DIN reproduction or new target-attention claim.

Opened authorized original arXiv2508.11565v1 PDF abstract/introduction/related-work excerpts (pages1-3), and read pinned benchmark INFNet lines180-313 plus benchmark section2.3. INFNet uses task proxies and homogeneous/heterogeneous information flow. Here no task proxy, proxy attention, PGU, hub broadcast or extra layer is adopted; only an existing summary derivative is selected by task. Its external results do not establish local transfer.

Only authorized author README is available/read; full publisher paper remains unverified. Its warning that shopping behavior has category/brand/type rather than item IDs reinforces retaining this benchmark's impression-history versus auxiliary-label distinction. No auxiliary target conversion interpretation or DMR novelty comparison is claimed.

inherited_components: Entire r0068 standalone Model, _SummaryProductVJP forward/backward and per-row norm helper
Field/action embeddings; ten uniform/feedback compression blocks; attached rotated normalization support and folded train/pruned eval execution
Signed target-conditioned local activation, five masked detail summaries, target-match counts, separate task residual adapters and heads
Per-task rank16 context queries/history projections/output maps, blockwise tanh summary and live product RMS normalization
All source gradient gates and independent auxiliary scorer running buffers; native query derivatives; default BCE objective; no training_loss override
study.proposed_difference: Replace r0068's single auxiliary_summary_vjp selector with cartfav_summary_vjp and buy_summary_vjp, each native or removed_restored. primary_summary_vjp must be native. Route by feature_map label identity, never current labels, sample identity or task position assumptions. All four modules instantiate and execute identical operators; only the two constant modes differ. Cell00 native/native and cell11 transformed/transformed reproduce existing r0068 endpoints at common state. Cell10 transformed cart/fav with native buy is the candidate; cell01 is its complementary control. This is a mechanism-attribution follow-up to a failed predictive implementation, not a new architecture or priority claim. Trajectory review: initial compressed-task transplantation r0006=0.65919424 underperformed both imported source bests (0.66064694 and0.66016336); it was a predictive failure with successful execution. r0050 content-key transfer=0.66791389 lost to its blocked control=0.66828885, so auxiliary transfer is not uniformly beneficial across architectures. r0052 native block nonlinear summary remains best0.66852687. r0066 summary removal=0.66799921 and query removal=0.66834032, r0067 norm restoration=0.66799933 and native rescaling=0.66816467, and all three r0068 modified paths failed to beat native. Repeated native endpoint equality at one seed establishes reproducibility only, not independent repeated mechanism support. The available trajectory index reports successful execution for every recorded trial; weaker prediction is distinguished from missing data or execution failure. Failed official validate_task.py registry resolution this turn is preparation failure only; its costs remain charged.
predictions: At common learned state, all four cells have identical outputs and running-buffer updates in train and eval; learned tensor shapes/counts, initialization and host RNG remain equal. Endpoint trajectories should recover r0068 native and all-aux outcomes within host-established numerical tolerance; deviations require investigation before interpretation.

Provisional directional prediction: cartfav_summary_direction click AUC exceeds all_aux_summary_direction, while buy_summary_direction is below native_summary_bridge; no guaranteed improvement over native is assumed. A selective gain >=0.0001 over native motivates replication, not a significance claim.

The cart/fav-only cell may retain the favorite-AUC gain of the unsuccessful all-aux intervention while recovering buy AUC. If gains simply track auxiliary task metrics without click recovery, they do not satisfy primary selection.

All cells should have 32192421 total, 31793216 embedding and 399205 dense parameters and comparable measured cost, since VJP alternatives are all computed in the unchanged backward. Cost equality must be measured; host dense clipping/optimizer updates need not match.
falsifiers: If either endpoint fails common-state prediction/gradient/buffer parity against its r0068 counterpart, or masks/source gradient ownership fail, stop and correct implementation before interpreting AUC.
If cart/fav-only does not recover click AUC relative to all-aux, the specific native-buy recovery prediction is unsupported; an opposite sign is counterevidence, not a favorable reinterpretation.

If neither selective cell exceeds native click AUC, this implementation has no demonstrated predictive benefit, irrespective of auxiliary improvements. Close this direction branch after this bounded factorial.
If apparent gains disappear under authorized paired seeds/user-cluster uncertainty or are explained by runtime/parameter differences, retain a preliminary/null outcome rather than mechanism support.

Even with a positive factorial contrast, unmeasured clipping and later shared-context trajectories prevent a direct gradient-conflict claim. A future discriminating diagnostic must observe these mediators without altering the frozen host clip/recipe.
alternative_explanations: Single fixed seed with extensive prior validation selection; replay is not an independent replication
Restored norm is per-example at the summary interface, not a matched norm of accumulated parameter gradients or optimizer steps
Global dense clipping may immediately couple otherwise task-specific updates; later task-specific states alter shared-context query gradients
Cart and fav are grouped from exploratory observed outcomes; their individual contributions remain unresolved
Nonlinear learning trajectories and BF16 may create interactions; cross-task effects alone do not identify direct gradient conflict
The grouping may reflect label prevalence (cart10428, fav7717, buy4036 validation positives) rather than a semantic task difference; all use category/brand-based24h auxiliary labels.
The best click incumbent still has weaker auxiliary AUCs than baseline DIN (cart0.84907/fav0.86490/buy0.87018); click improvement is not uniform four-task superiority.
Long history and frequency/population changes may mediate effects; reported fixed history bins are exploratory and cannot identify a mechanism alone.

Earlier task splits do not establish the present hypothesis: r0033 cart/fav-context-only=0.66689148 and buy-only=0.66664263; r0044 product-cart/fav-only=0.66794155 and buy-only=0.66754723. Those different context-edge interventions favored cart/fav over buy. They are historical counterevidence to any broad assertion that buy is always the useful auxiliary task, not matched controls for this summary-projection VJP question.
